name: What preparation is needed before installing new kitchen floor tile?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before installing new kitchen floor tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a long-lasting tile installation. This typically involves removing old flooring, ensuring the subfloor is clean, level, and structurally sound. Any cracks or unevenness in the subfloor must be repaired. A cement backer board or uncoupling membrane may be installed to provide a stable, crack-resistant base for the tiles. This step helps prevent future issues like cracked grout or tiles due to subfloor movement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before tile installation, old flooring is removed, and the subfloor must be clean, level, and structurally sound. Backer board or an uncoupling membrane may be installed.
